text:
maria: Quick PSA — ran into two DX gaps on the Node SDK vs REST while wiring up the sampleapp embedding flow. TL;DR: bulk-array embedding support is inconsistent and the `truncate` param behavior differs.

kevin: Can you paste minimal repro + SDK version? I can take a look.

maria: SDK v0.8.3. Repro (very small):

```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
// REST accepts array of inputs for a single request, SDK errors
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'text-embed-001', input: ['hello', 'world'], truncate: 'end' });
```

On the sampleapp this used to be a single call for a batch of texts. With the SDK above we get: `TypeError: input must be a string` coming from the SDK request validation. If I switch to the REST curl with identical JSON payload the server accepts it (200) and returns embeddings for both inputs.

jin: Interesting. So REST accepts array but SDK is validating client-side and only allowing string. That would break all batch workflows. Also, what about `truncate`?

maria: Right — second issue: REST docs say `truncate` is an enum: `none | start | end` (defaults to `none`). The SDK accepts a boolean `truncate` (defaults to true) and silently converts enums -> boolean (any non-empty string -> true). End result: REST default none vs SDK default true causes shorter embeddings and occasional regressions in quality tests.

kevin: Oof. Two separate problems: (A) client-side param validation shape for `input` (should accept string|string[]) and (B) param normalization for `truncate`. Thanks for the repro.

sam: @kevin I can help with a quick fix in the validation layer. We should: 1) allow array for `input` and pass through as-is, 2) stop converting enum->boolean for `truncate`, instead send the raw value, and 3) add an integration test against the local mock server to catch regressions.

kevin: Plan sounds good. I'll open a branch. Work items:
- add `embeddings.createMany` shim (backcompat) OR accept array on `create`
- update param schema for `truncate` and add tests
- add sampleapp CI job that runs the embedding smoke test with small batch

jin: Recommend accept array on `create` first for minimal API churn, then add a `createMany` convenience later. Also add a note in CHANGELOG about the behavior change.

kevin: I'll do that. Assigning to self. PR incoming (will ping here).

maria: Thanks! Also if you can bump patch in SDK and ship before next sampleapp deploy that'd be ideal — the onboarding walkthrough hits this path and confuses new users. :pray:

deploy-bot: CI started for branch sdk/allow-embeddings-array (build #4821).

kevin: CI green. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/321 — changes: accept input: string|string[], fix truncate passthrough, add two tests. Please review @jin @sam.

jin: Reviewed, small nit on test naming. LGTM after fix.

sam: Verified local sampleapp with SDK build artifact — batch embed flow OK.

maria: Verified sampleapp onboarding tutorial; embedding quality matches REST now. Thanks team :tada:

kevin: Merged and published v0.8.4. Changelog entry: "embeddings: accept batch input arrays; preserve `truncate` enum values; fix client-side validation".

maria: Closing loop — leaving a short note in the sampleapp README about which SDK versions are compatible.

kevin: Thanks for reporting! If anyone sees other param drift please ping `#devex`. :eyes:
